functions.name: WindowsMessagePump
functions.summary: Standard Windows message pump. Enters a do-while loop while PeekMessageA reports queued messages, then retrieves each message with GetMessageA. On WM_QUIT GetMessageA returns zero and the loop breaks. Otherwise TranslateMessage and DispatchMessageA process the message. Returns the result of the last PeekMessageA/GetMessageA call.

operations.description: Call PeekMessageA(&Msg, 0, 0, 0, 0) to check whether a message is queued without blocking; non-zero return means a message is pending.
Iterate the pump while the PeekMessageA result is non-zero; the loop re-evaluates PeekMessageA each iteration as its condition.
Exit the loop when PeekMessageA returns zero (no messages left in the queue) or when GetMessageA returns zero.
Call GetMessageA(&Msg, 0, 0, 0) to retrieve the queued message into the local MSG struct; a zero return signals WM_QUIT.
Break out of the loop if GetMessageA returns zero (WM_QUIT received), so no further messages are processed.
Call TranslateMessage(&Msg) to convert virtual-key messages into character messages.
Call DispatchMessageA(&Msg) to dispatch the message to the target window procedure.
Return the result of the last PeekMessageA/GetMessageA call (non-zero normally, zero when the queue is empty or WM_QUIT was received).

functions.name: UintToBaseString
functions.summary: Unsigned integer to string conversion in a caller-supplied base a3. When negate flag a4 is nonzero a leading '-' is written and a1 is negated first. Digits are emitted least-significant first as '0'-'9' (value + 48) or 'a'-'z' (value + 87), the buffer is null-terminated, and the digit run is reversed in place. Returns the last character moved by the reversal.

Return the last character swapped during reversal (the value now at the start of the digit run).
